title: StreamConnector patterns for TS SDK: resumable async-iterator <-> WebStream interop
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a composable StreamConnector abstraction in the TypeScript SDK to unify AsyncIterator and WHATWG ReadableStream (Web Streams) consumption/production patterns. This ticket covers design, API surface, example snippets, retry semantics for resumable streams, backpressure propagation, and migration guidance for existing streaming helpers.
background: We have many ad-hoc adapters in the codebase to convert between AsyncIterator and Web Streams (examples, helpers, and shims). Consumers report friction when mixing consumption styles across runtimes (Node/Deno/Browser) and when applying retry/restore semantics to streaming responses (e.g., LLM partial outputs). Current patterns either lose cancellation/backpressure signals or require duplicating checkpoint logic across call sites.
proposal:
Introduce a small runtime-agnostic StreamConnector API that:
  - exposes unified factories: fromAsyncIterable(), fromWebStream(), toAsyncIterable(), toWebStream()
  - supports optional checkpoint emissions (checkpointToken) emitted by the source so resumable retries can rehydrate state
  - includes an explicit FlowControlToken consumer can await to propagate backpressure across adapter boundaries
  - provides composition helpers: tee(), transform(), mapChunks(), retryWithCheckpoint()

The connector will be shipped in the TS SDK under src/stream/connector and documented with migration examples. The design intentionally avoids coupling to Redwood runtime internals so it can be extracted and tested in isolation.
tasks: Write design doc and API surface proposal in docs/stream-connector.md and link from PR
Implement core StreamConnector class with adapters: fromAsyncIterable, fromWebStream, fromCallbackProducer
Implement flow-control token wiring and tests that assert backpressure propagation across adapter boundary
Add checkpoint emission semantics and implement retryWithCheckpoint helper (unit + integration tests)
Add migration examples for existing consumer patterns in examples/streaming/connector-migration.ts
Create TS SDK docs page and a short migration guide (console quickstart + README)
Open GitHub PR, request review from @eng-streaming and @sdk-ts owners, and iterate on feedback
acceptance_criteria: Core connector implemented and exported from sdk package (src/stream/connector) with type definitions
Unit tests covering adapter conversions, tee, transform, and flow-control behaviour (>=90% coverage for module)
Integration test demonstrating retryWithCheckpoint resumes from the latest checkpoint token across a simulated transient error
Examples and migration guide added to the repo with a working demo in examples/streaming/connector-migration.ts
Performance benchmark comparing old adapters vs connector for Node streaming scenario (same or better latency under backpressure)
Design doc and API proposal reviewed and approved by eng streaming guild (one approval + 2 reviewers)
